name: Why do remodeling estimates vary significantly between contractors?

mainEntity.name: Why do remodeling estimates vary significantly between contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Estimates can vary due to differences in contractor experience, overhead, proposed materials, and the level of detail in the scope of work. Some contractors might include higher-quality finishes or more extensive prep work, while others may bid on a more basic scope. Differences in insurance, warranty coverage, and subcontractor relationships also influence pricing. Always compare what's included in each estimate, not just the final number.
acceptedAnswer.description: Estimates vary due to differences in contractor experience, materials, scope of work, overhead, and insurance. Compare what's included, not just the total cost.
